m1.typescript: m1 an agent loses the tools its role does not need and the risky ones among them are named

e1.typescript: e1 a tool that is held and needed but never used is reported as dormant and never removed

e2.typescript: e2 a small set loads whole and a large one defers when it has ten tools or over ten thousand tokens

e3.typescript: e3 the number of tools kept loaded stays between three and five and ties are broken by name

e4.typescript: e4 the mechanism follows the counterpart then the path then the number of clients

e5.typescript: e5 a call needs the users scope and the agents scope and an unknown tool is refused

e6.typescript: e6 the gateway checks the credential then the model then the tool then the rate

e7.typescript: e7 the gateway keeps a record of every decision with the team or unknown and no content

wrong-risky-everything.defect: names every removed tool as risky

wrong-dormant-removed.defect: removes a needed tool because nobody used it

wrong-defer-count-only.defect: ignores the size of the definitions when it decides whether to defer

wrong-keep-unclamped.defect: keeps as many tools loaded as it is asked to, with no floor or ceiling

wrong-ties-by-insertion.defect: breaks a tie in usage by the order the tools were listed

wrong-mechanism-path-first.defect: answers a call in code before it asks whether the counterpart is an agent

wrong-auth-user-only.defect: lets any call through that the user may make, whatever the agent holds

wrong-gateway-rate-first.defect: counts the rate before it checks the model

wrong-gateway-audit-empty-on-deny.defect: keeps no record of a denied request
